content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle provide varying levels of service for digital product sales, but in the context of Nigeria, their offerings are severely limited. Stripe, for example, is unavailable, while PayPal can suspend accounts without recourse, which cripples cash flow. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also restrict access based on location, limiting creators to few choices. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, exemplified by COREMERCH, provides a complete stack that includes hosting, payment processing, and product delivery, all while ensuring the creator retains ownership and control. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-16|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-26|The Real]] stands in stark contrast to the proprietary solutions that keep creators locked out of the global marketplace.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The major platforms often cite regulatory and compliance issues as reasons for their exclusions, leaving creators in countries like Nigeria stranded. PayPal's practices can lead to account freezes for extended periods without appeal, further complicating access to funds. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses these restrictions entirely. By utilizing free hosting from GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can operate without the constraints imposed by traditional payment platforms. This approach not only provides immediate access but also future-proofs their businesses from arbitrary restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing time with conventional platforms can be frustratingly slow, with PayPal holding funds for up to 180 days in case of disputes. Additionally, transaction fees can eat into profits. For example, PayPal charges around 3% per transaction, which can be devastating for digital creators. In contrast, using NOWPayments with sovereign commerce infrastructure minimizes fees to just 0.5% while offering immediate payment verification. This means creators can access their funds without delay and retain a greater portion of their earnings, making it a far superior option for anyone serious about selling digital products.
Retain complete ownership of your digital assets.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital assets is another critical issue. With platforms like Stripe and PayPal, creators often face restrictions on data and product access after deployment, which jeopardizes their business continuity. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that creators own everything after deployment. The entire stack can be automated for seamless product delivery and payment processing, allowing creators to focus on their content rather than logistics. This level of control not only enhances operational efficiency but also fosters a stronger connection between creators and their audience.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For Nigerian creators, the architecture that best supports immediate and sustainable commerce is the Edge Commerce Stack offered by COREMERCH. Deployed in just 48 hours, it integrates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, allowing for five products to be loaded and configured for success. This stack provides full ownership, eliminates reliance on conventional payment platforms, and ensures that creators can operate efficiently in their local environment while tapping into global markets.

This approach allows you to set up a fully functional online store using free tools and automatic crypto payments without dependency on platforms that exclude you based on geography. Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
